description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeSkillService component within the OrangeHRM PIM module. It contains unit tests to verify the behavior of EmployeeSkillService methods, specifically focusing on retrieving and setting the EmployeeSkillDao dependency.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillServiceTest
classes.description: A unit test class for EmployeeSkillService, verifying its methods related to DAO retrieval and assignment.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeSkillService instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSkillDao
methods.description: Tests that getEmployeeSkillDao() returns an instance of EmployeeSkillDao.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSkillDaoBySetter
methods.description: Tests that setting an EmployeeSkillDao object via setEmployeeSkillDao() correctly updates the service to return the expected DAO.
